pr_title: ddl: job context will be canceled when cancel or pause job
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:

2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: ref #56398 close #56017

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

This PR aims to remove the logic that periodically return to main loop and check job state. Instead, the job execution can occupy the main goroutine for a long time and a background goroutine checks the job state and cancel the context.
